title: Al-Ghashiyah 88:12-16 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ghashiyah, the makharij and the rules of laam
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ghashiyah 88:12-16 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 13. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ (١٢) فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ (١٣) وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ (١٤) وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ (١٥) وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ (١٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Within it is a flowing spring.
Within it are couches raised high

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ghashiyah 88:12-16 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 88:12-16 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 88:12-16 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the five blessings of Paradise in 88:12 to 16.
questions.a: A flowing spring, raised couches, cups, cushions in rows, carpets spread out.

questions.q: Link 88:1 to 16 and recite to a partner.
questions.a: All 16 ayat in order with no more than two prompts.

questions.q: 88:12 says that in Paradise there is ...
questions.a: A) a flowing spring. 'Within it is a flowing spring' (88:12).

questions.q: Think again: If you could describe a beautiful place without using pictures, only words, which words would you choose?
questions.a: Allah describes Paradise with flowing springs, raised couches, cups, cushions and carpets (88:12 to 16).
